technologies.name: Sugar Cane
technologies.description: Sugar Cane can be used to produce Refined Sugar which is much prized by Apprentice Workers.
technologies.source: Original English string 43329; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Tobacco
technologies.description: Tobacco can be used to produce Cigars which are much prized by Journeyman Workers.
technologies.source: Original English string 43330; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Furs
technologies.description: Furs can be used to produce Hats which are much prized by Master Artisans.
technologies.source: Original English string 43331; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Gold or Silver
technologies.description: Silver and Gold can be converted to cash ($100 and $200/unit) once they are transported back to our capital.
technologies.source: Original English string 43332; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Gems or Diamonds
technologies.description: Gems and Diamonds can be converted to cash ($300 and $400/unit) once they are transported back to our capital.
technologies.source: Original English string 43333; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Cotton
technologies.description: Cotton can be used to produce Fabric.
technologies.source: Original English string 43334; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Spices
technologies.description: Spices can be converted to cash ($50/unit) once they are transported back to our capital.
technologies.source: Original English string 43335; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Mine Engineering
technologies.description: Mine Engineering allows Engineers to upgrade our fortifications to level 2 .  This advance also leads to improved mining technology.
technologies.source: Original English string 43336; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Land Enclosure
technologies.description: Land Enclosure makes efficient farms possible. Builders may increase grain output to two units per turn.  This change in our society permits later military advances and reorganization.
technologies.source: Original English string 43337; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Saw Mill
technologies.description: This technology permits builders to construct saw mills on forested land increasing output to two units per turn. Increasing availability of wood products leads to research opportunities in education and naval technology.
technologies.source: Original English string 43338; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Superior Hull Design
technologies.description: Hull design advances permit construction of  Fluytes. These large merchant vessels  have a larger cargo capacity than the Carrack  but poor armament for fighting.
technologies.source: Original English string 43339; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Crop Rotation
technologies.description: Crop Rotation allows growth of fodder crops that permit builders to improve our cattle herds. This leads to further advances in sheep and cattle herding as well as the military uses of horse herds.
technologies.source: Original English string 43340; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Diplomatic Expertise
technologies.description: Diplomatic Expertise  permits diplomats to offer embassies to Minor Nations.  Once embassies exist, treaties and grants may be made, and Merchants, Engineers, and  Builders may work in the Minor Nation.
technologies.source: Original English string 43341; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Sugar Refining
technologies.description: This advance permits production of refined sugar. This luxury is consumed each turn by Apprentice Workers.
technologies.source: Original English string 43342; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Sugar Planting
technologies.description: Sugar Plantations increase the productivity of sugar farms. Builders may develop sugar farms to produce 2 units of sugar cane per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43343; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Cigar Production
technologies.description: This advance permits production of cigars from tobacco. This luxury is consumed each turn by journeymen workers.
technologies.source: Original English string 43344; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Tobacco Planting
technologies.description: Tobacco Plantations increase the productivity of tobacco farms. Builders may develop tobacco farms to produce 2 units of tobacco per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43345; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Hat Production
technologies.description: This advance allows production of hats from furs. This luxury is consumed each turn by master artisans.
technologies.source: Original English string 43346; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Improved Trapping Techniques
technologies.description: Fur Trapping technology allows builders to develop trapping grounds to produce 2 units of furs per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43347; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Improved Sea Routes
technologies.description: With this knowledge of sea routes reducing spoilage,  more spices from upgraded spice farms become available.  This development leads to improvements in naval technology as well.
technologies.source: Original English string 43348; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Cotton Weaving
technologies.description: This technology allows production of fabric from cotton.  This fabric may be used interchangeably with fabric produced from wool.
technologies.source: Original English string 43349; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Cotton Planting
technologies.description: Cotton Plantations increase the productivity of cotton farms. Builders may develop cotton farms to produce 2 units of cotton per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43350; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Merchant Companies
technologies.description: Merchant companies permit construction of  merchant units, which buy land in Minor Nations.  This paves the way for development by our builders and ultimately overseas profits.
technologies.source: Original English string 43351; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Apprentice Workers
technologies.description: Apprentice workers produce four times as much labor as an untrained peasant. Each turn, an apprentice worker consumes refined sugar.
technologies.source: Original English string 43352; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Large Sugar Plantations
technologies.description: Large sugar plantations increase the productivity of sugar farms. Builders may develop sugar farms to produce 3 units of sugar cane per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43353; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Trade Fairs
technologies.description: Trade Fairs permit our traders to enter bids on up to six different commodities each turn.  This development leads to banking and increased funding for the military.
technologies.source: Original English string 43354; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Seed Drill
technologies.description: The Seed drill permits builders to improve grain farms to produce 3 units of grain per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43355; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Organized Regiments
technologies.description: The new regimental system permits the construction of Lancer units and the upgrading of Knights to Lancers. This development also leads to both new weapons and new tactics.
technologies.source: Original English string 43356; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Large Cotton Plantations
technologies.description: Large Cotton Plantations increase the productivity of cotton farms. Builders may develop cotton farms to produce 3 units of cotton per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43357; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Coal Mining
technologies.description: Coal mining knowledge allows builders to construct mines producing one unit of coal per turn. Coal mining eventually leads to the development of the crucible process for steel making.
technologies.source: Original English string 43358; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Iron Mining
technologies.description: Improved mining of iron permits builders to upgrade iron mines to produce 2 units per turn. Iron mining leads to the  production of steel, a key element for the growth of military and transportation technology.
technologies.source: Original English string 43359; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Copper and Tin Mining
technologies.description: Improved copper and tin mine technology  permits builders to upgrade mines.  Copper and tin are used to create bronze; a critical material for construction of artillery, ships, and fortifications until the development of steel.
technologies.source: Original English string 43360; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Precious Metals Mining
technologies.description: Improved mining of silver and gold permits builders to upgrade precious metal mines to produce 2 units per turn.  These metals convert directly to cash for our empire.
technologies.source: Original English string 43361; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Precious Stone Mining
technologies.description: Improved mining of diamonds and gems permits builders to upgrade precious stone mines to produce 2 units per turn.  These gem stones convert directly to cash for our empire.
technologies.source: Original English string 43362; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Navigation
technologies.description: New abilities in the field of navigation permit our shipwrights to construct small fast sloops ideal for privateering. This development leads to improved naval technologies.
technologies.source: Original English string 43363; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Printing Press
technologies.description: The printing press increases the efficiency of all technological research and leads to later developments in military tactics, education, and labor.
technologies.source: Original English string 43364; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Wind Saw Mill
technologies.description: The wind saw mill permits our builders to upgrade timber camps to produce 3 units of timber per turn. This increased timber output leads to improvements in naval technology such as the construction of larger ships.
technologies.source: Original English string 43365; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Recruit Steppe Horsemen
technologies.description: Improvements in organization and the growth of our herds permits recruiting and training of steppe horsemen.  These fast Cossack units are used for scouting and disrupting our foes. Later light cavalry units will develop from these forces.
technologies.source: Original English string 43366; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Animal Husbandry
technologies.description: Advances in animal husbandry permit builders to improve cattle ranches to produce 3 units of meat per turn. This development eventually leads to new uses of horses to pull artillery, and to superior cavalry tactics.
technologies.source: Original English string 43367; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Sheep Ranching
technologies.description: Advancements in sheep ranching allow builders to improve sheep farms to produce 2 wool per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43368; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Convoying
technologies.description: The convoying advance allows construction of galleons.  Although slow, these powerful, large vessels are ideal for convoying products from the new world.
technologies.source: Original English string 43369; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Money Lending
technologies.description: With the development of money lending, our empire can borrow more money and pay interest at a lower rate. This advance leads to superior bureaucratic organization and, eventually, to upgrades in provincial artillery forces.
technologies.source: Original English string 43370; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Trained Journeymen
technologies.description: This technology permits training of journeymen who produce six times as much labor as an untrained peasant. Each turn, a journeyman worker consumes a cigar.
technologies.source: Original English string 43371; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Sugar Industry
technologies.description: Development of a sugar growing industry allows builders to upgrade sugar farms to produce 4 units of sugar per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43372; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Large Tobacco Plantations
technologies.description: Large tobacco plantations increase the productivity of tobacco farms. Builders may develop tobacco farms to produce 3 units of tobacco per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43373; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Road Construction
technologies.description: Improvements to the land transport system permit our roads to move 2 units of commodities from each connected mine, farm, or ranch.  This development leads to railroads.
technologies.source: Original English string 43374; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Moldboard Plow
technologies.description: With the development of the moldboard plow, our builders may  improve grain farms to produce 4 units of grain per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43375; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Improved Iron Weapons
technologies.description: Improved casting and forging of iron weapons permits the recruiting of Halberdiers. Pikemen may be upgraded to this new type of unit. This advance leads to the bayonet and other military knowledge.
technologies.source: Original English string 43376; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Weapon Craftsmanship
technologies.description: Improved weapon craftsmanship permits the recruiting and equipping of musketeer regiments and the upgrading of the outdated arquebusiers. These skills lead to advances in explosives and other weapon technology.
technologies.source: Original English string 43377; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Square Set Timbering
technologies.description: Square-set timbering permits the construction of deeper coal mines and allows builders to upgrade our mines to produce 2 units of coal per turn. Coal mining leads to large-scale industrial developments.
technologies.source: Original English string 43378; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Improved Infantry Tactics
technologies.description: Our increasing understanding of infantry tactics permits the recruitment of Calivermen, and the upgrading of peasant levies. These new regiments are adept at drawing enemy fire and using terrain for concealment.
technologies.source: Original English string 43379; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Steam in Mining
technologies.description: Early developments using steam power permit deeper more efficient iron mines. Builders can upgrade mines to produce 3 units of iron per turn. This development leads to steel making.
technologies.source: Original English string 43380; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Large Copper and Tin Mines
technologies.description: Increasing knowledge of metallurgy and mining permits builders to upgrade copper and tin mines to produce 3 units per turn. This development leads to new ship classes equipped with larger bronze cannons.
technologies.source: Original English string 43381; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Siege Engineering
technologies.description: Improved understanding of siege engineering permits the construction of royal artillery regiments and the upgrading of the outdated culverin.  This development leads to improvements in emplaced and heavy artillery, and fort construction.
technologies.source: Original English string 43382; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Privateering Companies
technologies.description: The growth and funding of privateering companies improves the chances of naval interception and leads to later development of advanced ship classes.
technologies.source: Original English string 43383; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Large Spice Plantations
technologies.description: Large spice plantations increase the productivity of spice farms. Builders may develop spice farms to produce 3 units of spices per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43384; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: University
technologies.description: The university permits funding of a fourth research project and leads to advances in military, naval, and industrial technologies.
technologies.source: Original English string 43385; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Improved Cavalry Tactics
technologies.description: Our increasing understanding of cavalry tactics permits the recruitment of Harquebusiers. These new regiments are the first to use firearms in the saddle and lead to later heavy cavalry.
technologies.source: Original English string 43386; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Large Hulls
technologies.description: This technology allows construction of a new large cargo vessel, the Indiaman, which carries 25% more cargo than a galleon. This development leads to large-hulled warships.
technologies.source: Original English string 43387; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Horse Artillery
technologies.description: Improving horse breeds and lighter cannons allow our generals to recruit horse-drawn artillery that can be fired and relocated rapidly on the battlefield.
technologies.source: Original English string 43388; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: National Bureaucracy
technologies.description: With the growth of national bureaucracy, our builders may upgrade provincial towns. An upgraded town produces materials for transport consistent with the types of developed resources in its province.
technologies.source: Original English string 43389; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Improved Sail Design
technologies.description: Improvements in sail design have led our shipwrights to a fast light merchant vessel, the trader.  These sails will later be useful for faster warships as well.
technologies.source: Original English string 43390; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Master Artisans
technologies.description: This advance permits training of master artisans, who produce 8 times as much labor as an untrained peasant. Master artisans demand the luxury of a fur hat every turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43391; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Cotton Gin
technologies.description: The invention of the cotton gin permits builders to upgrade cotton plantations to produce 4 units of cotton per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43392; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Heavy Emplaced Artillery
technologies.description: With this development the emplaced royal artillery in all of our empire’s forts is automatically upgraded to heavy artillery.
technologies.source: Original English string 43393; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Early Steam Engine
technologies.description: Railroads can be constructed by the rail builder unit in any flat terrain which includes a road. Railroads can transport up to 4 commodities from a single farm, mine, timber camp, or ranch.
technologies.source: Original English string 43394; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Crucible Process
technologies.description: The crucible process allows steel to be made from coal and iron. Steel is used to construct  the most advanced types of military and naval forces.
technologies.source: Original English string 43395; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Large Coal Mines
technologies.description: Large coal mines can be constructed by a builder. These mines produce 3 units of coal per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43396; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Modern Fortifications
technologies.description: The development of modern forts allows our Engineers to upgrade our fortifications to level 3 .  This advance also leads to improved types of heavy artillery.
technologies.source: Original English string 43397; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Ship of the Line
technologies.description: Improvements in hull design and bronze metallurgy permit shipwrights to construct ships of the line.
technologies.source: Original English string 43398; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Extraction of Precious Metals
technologies.description: Improved extraction of silver and gold permits builders to upgrade precious metal mines to produce 3 units per turn.  These metals convert directly to cash for our empire.
technologies.source: Original English string 43399; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Large Precious Stone Mines
technologies.description: Improved mining of diamonds and gems permits builders to upgrade precious stone mines to produce 3 units per turn.  These gem stones convert directly to cash for our empire.
technologies.source: Original English string 43400; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Circular Saw
technologies.description: Invention of the circular saw permits builders to upgrade timber camps  to produce 4 timber per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43401; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Industrial Machinery
technologies.description: New industrial machinery decreases the cost of military attack by 25%. This development later leads to weapon advances and industrial funding of research.
technologies.source: Original English string 43402; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Hussars
technologies.description: Improved training facilities and new horse breeds allow the recruiting of hussars and the upgrading of cossacks. Hussar regiments are very fast and exceptionally difficult to destroy.
technologies.source: Original English string 43403; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Scientific Cattle Breeding
technologies.description: The development of  scientific cattle breeding permits builders to upgrade cattle ranches to produce 4 units of  meat per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43404; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Scientific Sheep Breeding
technologies.description: The development of  scientific sheep breeding permits builders to upgrade sheep ranches to produce 3 units of  wool per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43405; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Advanced Hull Design
technologies.description: Developments in hull and sail design permit the construction of  frigates. Frigates are fast, powerful warships ideal for privateering and interception.
technologies.source: Original English string 43406; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Propaganda
technologies.description: Propaganda decreases the diplomatic penalties suffered when our empire declares war. This development leads to the growth of  nationalism.
technologies.source: Original English string 43407; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Banking
technologies.description: Banking decreases the interest rate when we borrow money and permits negative spending of larger sums. It later leads to improved military funding.
technologies.source: Original English string 43408; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Riverboats
technologies.description: Steam powered riverboats permit greater exploitation of  fur bearing animals. Builders can upgrade trapper camps to produce three units per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43409; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Later Steam Engine
technologies.description: With improved steam engines our rail builder may now construct rail through hills and swamps.
technologies.source: Original English string 43410; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Bayonet
technologies.description: The development of the bayonet permits recruiting of regulars and upgrading of  Halberdiers. Regulars are the first infantry adept at both melee and ranged combat.
technologies.source: Original English string 43411; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Explosives
technologies.description: Improvement of explosives allows recruiting of grenadiers and upgrading of musketeers.
technologies.source: Original English string 43412; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Early Rifles
technologies.description: The new rifled gun barrel permits slow and accurate fire, ideal for the new skirmisher regiments. Calivermen may be upgraded.
technologies.source: Original English string 43413; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Heavy Artillery
technologies.description: Powerful heavy artillery made of steel can now be built. Royal artillery upgrades to this new type of regiment.
technologies.source: Original English string 43414; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Industrial Funding of Research
technologies.description: The growth of business and industry creates new sources for research funding, increasing the efficiency of all research.  This leads to improved military and naval technology.
technologies.source: Original English string 43415; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Efficient Extraction of Copper & Tin
technologies.description: Improved extraction of copper and tin permits builders to upgrade mines to produce 4 units per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43416; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Improved Cavalry Weapons
technologies.description: Improved cavalry weapons allow the recruiting of Cuirassiers and the upgrading of Harquebusiers.
technologies.source: Original English string 43417; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Improved Food Preservation
technologies.description: Improvements in food preservation allow builders to upgrade spice farms to produce 4 units of spices per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43418; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Light Artillery Tactics
technologies.description: New tactics for light artillery combined with steel construction permit recruiting of Light artillery regiments and upgrading horse artillery.
technologies.source: Original English string 43419; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Paddlewheels
technologies.description: Steam driven paddlewheels for ocean-going vessels permit shipwrights to construct the raider, a fast destructive privateering ship.
technologies.source: Original English string 43420; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Spinning Jenny
technologies.description: The invention of the spinning jenny allows builders to upgrade sheep farms to produce 4 units of wool per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43421; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Tobacco Industry
technologies.description: Development of tobacco industry permits builders to upgrade tobacco farms to produce 4 tobacco per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43422; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Clipper Ships
technologies.description: This development permits shipwrights to construct clipper ships,  relatively small merchant sailing vessels with exceptional speed.
technologies.source: Original English string 43423; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Nationalism
technologies.description: Nationalism permits larger attack  and defense forces in each province.  The limit is now 12 regiments.  The presence of a general allows a further increase.
technologies.source: Original English string 43424; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Dynamite
technologies.description: Dynamite permits the construction of railroads through mountainous terrain. This development leads to further  advances in mining technology as well.
technologies.source: Original English string 43425; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Emplaced Siege Guns
technologies.description: With this discovery our siege engineers  automatically upgrade all our emplaced artillery to siege guns, the most powerful artillery that can be constructed.
technologies.source: Original English string 43426; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Merchant Steamships
technologies.description: This development allows shipwrights to build a huge new merchant steamship with vast cargo capacity.
technologies.source: Original English string 43427; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Excessive Fur Harvesting
technologies.description: New trapping and hunting techniques allow our builders to upgrade fur trading posts to produce 4 units of fur per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43428; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Needle Guns
technologies.description: The invention of the breechloading needle gun permits rifle infantry to be recruited. Our musket-bearing regular infantry may be upgraded.
technologies.source: Original English string 43429; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Modern Military Funding
technologies.description: Modern military funding allows less expensive attack movements by our land forces. This development later leads to the most powerful types of regiments.
technologies.source: Original English string 43430; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Advanced Iron Working
technologies.description: Advanced ironworking knowledge permits shipwrights to construct the ironclad; a heavily armored warship capable of inflicting damage at long ranges.
technologies.source: Original English string 43431; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Scouting
technologies.description: Superior equipment and training of light cavalry forces permits the recruiting of scout regiments and the upgrading of hussars.
technologies.source: Original English string 43432; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Repeating Cavalry Carbine
technologies.description: Development of a seven shot repeating carbine allows the recruiting of carbine cavalry and the upgrading of cuirassier units.
technologies.source: Original English string 43433; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Empire Building
technologies.description: Greater understanding of foreign cultures and improved training of diplomats permits requests to other Great Powers to join the empire peacefully.  Acceptance depends on the economic and military might of the asking empire.
technologies.source: Original English string 43434; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Elite Military Training
technologies.description: New training techniques permit the recruiting of elite infantry regiments called guards. Grenadiers may be upgraded.
technologies.source: Original English string 43435; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Long Range Rifles
technologies.description: The invention of the long range target rifle permits the recruiting of sharpshooter regiments and the upgrading of skirmishers.
technologies.source: Original English string 43436; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: High Grade Steel
technologies.description: New high grade steel permits the construction of a mobile siege gun. Although slow, these gigantic guns can batter the strongest fortifications and are especially effective on defense. Heavy artillery may be upgraded.
technologies.source: Original English string 43437; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Field Artillery Tactics
technologies.description: New tactical know-how and superior metallurgy permits construction of  field artillery, the ideal unit for taking fortifications. Our light artillery may be upgraded.
technologies.source: Original English string 43438; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Industrial Iron Mining
technologies.description: Advances in explosives and industry allow builders to upgrade iron mines to produce 4 units of iron per turn
technologies.source: Original English string 43439; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Safety Lamp
technologies.description: The safety lamp permits coal miners to dig deeper, allowing builders to upgrade coal mines to produce 4 units of coal per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43440; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Amalgamation Process
technologies.description: With the amalgamation process, builders can upgrade all precious metals mines to produce 4 gold or silver per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43441; native technology initializer 0x639150

technologies.name: Geological Prospecting
technologies.description: Geological prospecting permits all precious stone mines to become more productive. Builders may upgrade mines to produce 4 gems or diamonds per turn.
technologies.source: Original English string 43442; native technology initializer 0x639150
